title: Product stereographic model
target_statement: Write \(E_n=\mathbb R^{n+1}\), \(S_n=\{x\in E_n:\|x\|=1\}\), and \(M_{n,N}=S_n^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\). The dimensions are natural numbers and may be zero. This is the finite product of the ordinary sphere models \(\mathcal R_n\). Its model vector space is \((\mathbb R^n)^{\operatorname{Fin}N}\); ModelPi carries the product model topology. It specifies the actual ContMDiff regularity convention.
